_comment: TEMPLATE matrix for rigs/generate-decision-eval-suite.ts. Four cells: two decision models, each
with the production state (BuildRoutingState) and Phase -1's structured state (BuildRoutingStateStructured).
The model IDs are filled in LOCALLY, never here. Copy this file OUTSIDE the repository, then give each
cell a modelId (and a vendorId, to pin the vendor too) from your own database:
- jev-*: the Jev decision model's MJ: AI Models.ID, once its metadata exists (plan Task 2.3);
- llm-decision-*: the 'LLM Decision' model's MJ: AI Models.ID (metadata/ai-models/.llm-decision-model.json).
Pass the copy with --matrix. As committed, no cell pins a model, so every cell runs whatever the
decision prompt selects and the Jev and LLM Decision cells are the same measurement; the generator warns.
Optional per cell: promptName (default 'Default Decision'); failover (default false when the cell pins
a model or vendor); inputPricePer1M / outputPricePer1M in USD (the dry-run cost estimate only).
temperature and seed are accepted and recorded, but the decision path does not pass them to the model:
the driver records them as not applied.
LLM Decision cells: pinning selects the Decision-typed 'LLM Decision' model. The chat model behind it is
chosen by its chat prompt's own model selection and failover, which the decision path cannot pin; each
run records that chat model as Model.ResolvedModel.
